channel.title: MeritHyre Blog
channel.description: Practical guides on AI recruiting, structured interviews, compliance and staffing workflows from the MeritHyre team.

item.title: Time-to-Hire vs Quality-of-Hire: Which Metric Should You Actually Track?
item.description: A side-by-side look at the two hiring metrics, the warning signs that speed is winning over quality, and a five-step way to start measuring how good your hires really are.

item.title: Candidate Fraud in Hiring: Spot Fake Profiles and Proxies
item.description: Deepfakes, proxy interviewees and invented profiles are reaching interview stages. Learn the warning signs and build a layered verification process that holds up.

item.title: AI Resume Screening vs Keyword Matching: Which Wins?
item.description: Exact-word filters and context-aware AI each have a place in screening. Compare how they handle synonyms, adjacent skills and fairness, and when a hybrid works best.

item.title: How to Write Job Descriptions That AI Can Screen Against
item.description: A practical framework for AI-ready job descriptions: a shared taxonomy, a three-tier qualification hierarchy and outcome-based duties, plus a before-and-after rewrite.

item.title: Who Owns Candidate Data in AI Recruiting? Contract Clauses to Check
item.description: Resumes, recordings, transcripts and match scores all flow to your AI recruiting vendor. These eight contract clauses decide who controls that data once you sign.

item.title: Structured Interview Scorecards: Templates and Best Practices Guide
item.description: What goes into a strong interview scorecard, from role outcomes and weighted competencies to anchored rating scales, with a free software engineer template to adapt.

item.title: AI Recruitment Automation: The Complete Guide to Fixing Hiring Bottlenecks
item.description: The capabilities that matter, use cases by team, how to evaluate platforms, a phased rollout plan and the KPIs that prove AI-native recruitment automation is working.

item.title: NYC Local Law 144 Compliance Checklist for AI Hiring Tools (2026)
item.description: Five steps to meet New York City’s AI hiring law: map your tools, commission an independent bias audit, publish the summary, notify candidates and handle data requests.

item.title: AI-Native vs. Bolt-On AI Recruiting: What’s Actually Different?
item.description: Bolt-on AI adds features to a legacy ATS; AI-native software is built around AI from the start. Here’s how the two differ in architecture, workflow, hidden costs and handoffs.

item.title: From Job Order to Ranked Shortlist: The AI-Native Staffing Workflow US Agencies Are Adopting
item.description: How AI-native staffing workflows take a job order through sourcing, screening and ranking before a recruiter steps in, and why US agencies are making the switch now.

item.title: Every recruiter has felt it: You fill the role, and three months later you’re starting the exact same search from zero.
item.description: Linear hiring funnels forget everything once a role closes, so every repeat search starts cold. Here’s what a loop-based model keeps, from runner-up candidates to post-hire data.

item.title: Why AI-Native Beats AI-Powered: The Architecture Difference That Changes Everything
item.description: AI-powered tools speed up the old recruiting workflow; AI-native platforms replace it. See what that architecture difference means for recruiters, compliance and your ATS.
